fixture_name: Ramp-terminal arterial reconstruction — US preliminary design (MassDOT HSIP municipal RSA, full package)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Undefined lane drop with abrupt striping termination, no advance signage, and observed late merges at the ramp mouth creating conflicts with left-turning ramp-exiting drivers is a substantive expectancy/decision-load safety issue squarely relevant at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Claims rest on recorded Safety Issue #2 field observations (striping termination, absent signage, observed merges) rather than invented content, but the only verbatim quote (EV-US-023) addresses RSA scope generally and does not verbatim-support the pivotal lane-drop/merge-behavior claim, capping below 2.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern about an operational aspect of the design rather than a standards-compliance question, with null normative basis note and the FHWA quote properly used to affirm that operational safety issues are the RSA focus.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: advance merge signage plus pavement markings before the ramp, plus a viable design alternative (extend two through lanes past the ramp with pre-signed mandatory right-turn trade-off) carried into the ongoing reconstruction.
justifications.vru_coverage: Not the primary affected user class since the conflict mechanism is vehicle-to-vehicle, but pedestrian exposure at the adjacent mid-block crosswalk is acknowledged and cross-referenced to JB-GF12-001, meriting 1.
